MEOWSKIT.ImportHint: Pick the folder Meows wrote (it has a kit.json in it). One scene per map, gridded or gridless, handouts and notes as journal entries, tokens as actors, the run sheet as a journal entry per scene with its tokens placed hidden, all in a folder named after the kit.
MEOWSKIT.MakeActorsHint: Each token in the kit becomes an actor of the system's monster type with the token as its picture. Off leaves the tokens as pictures in the folder.
MEOWSKIT.NoManifest: No kit.json in {folder} ({error}). Point at the folder Meows wrote.
MEOWSKIT.WrongVersion: This kit is version {found}; this module reads version {wanted}. Update one or the other.
MEOWSKIT.NoActorType: This system has no actor type to make, so the tokens stayed as pictures.
MEOWSKIT.Done: {title}: {scenes} scenes, {journals} journal entries, {actors} actors, {tokens} tokens placed, in folders named after the kit.
MEOWSKIT.PlaceTokensHint: Each fight's tokens are put on its scene, hidden, in a row at the top-left, ready to be dragged into place. Off leaves the fights as journal pages only.
MEOWSKIT.TokensFailed: Could not place the tokens on {name}: {error}
